subject: E-3159: cannot write data directory on Windows
body:
Good morning. My setup is MeshMail 2.8.0, Windows 11 23H2. Starting Tuesday, the moment I save my work a dialog reads "E-3159: cannot write to data directory".

After restoring from a backup the data folder came back read-only. I can open files from it but nothing can be saved into it.

I've already tried searching the help centre, which changed nothing.

Thanks, Sofia Rossi (Pinewood Legal)
